title: Payment Factor Table — Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing
content:
Every Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing plan repays over a fixed number of scheduled monthly payments. The table below holds, for each plan, the term, the payment factor per 1,000.00 financed and the floor of the scheduled monthly payment, together with the due-day terms that are the same on every plan.

## Term and payment factor by plan

| | Same-As-Cash 12 | Same-As-Cash 18 | Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Fixed-Rate 60 | Fixed-Rate 120 | Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled monthly payments from funding (months) | 12 | 18 | 24 | 60 | 120 | 144 |
| Payment factor per 1,000.00 financed (USD) | 83.34 | 55.56 | 41.67 | 19.80 | 13.21 | 13.13 |
| Minimum scheduled monthly payment (USD) | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |

## Rounding and due-day terms (all plans)

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rounding of every computed amount | To the nearest cent; an exact half cent rounds up |
| First payment | Due on the first payment due day falling at least 25 calendar days after funding |
| Earliest day of the month a payment may fall due | 1 |
| Latest day of the month a payment may fall due | 28 |
| Payment due day changes allowed in any rolling 365 days | 1 |

## Notes on the table

- The payment factor is stated per 1,000.00 financed; it is a dollar figure, not a rate.
- The minimum scheduled monthly payment is a floor: no plan's scheduled monthly payment is lower than the figure in its column.
- The due day is a day of the month from 1 through 28 on every plan.

## Illustration (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60 account and a hypothetical Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12 account are compared only to show how to read the columns: the first uses a factor of 19.80 per 1,000.00 financed and a floor of 25.00; the second uses 83.34 per 1,000.00 financed and a floor of 35.00. The figures chosen for any illustration are not plan terms.
